content.short: 1delta is a decentralized margin trading protocol aggregating $10B+ of lending market liquidity for low-cost, non-custodial leveraged positions.
content.description: 1delta is a next-generation margin trading protocol that aggregates liquidity from DeFi lending markets to enable capital-efficient leveraged positions in a single transaction. Users can borrow assets from money markets and simultaneously swap them to create leveraged long or short positions, with 1delta's smart routing ensuring best rates across multiple DEXes to minimize slippage and gas costs. The protocol is deployed on Mantle and deeply integrated with INIT Capital's liquidity hooks for seamless margin trading infrastructure.
